title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use blue and green curves for the species; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette (and line styles) that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All species distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: temperature-dependent networks
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: every step has the same fixed temperature.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Session 2 introduces Arrhenius for one step only.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: fit rate constants to noisy data
body:
## Problem
Session 3 only simulates; students ask how rate constants are found from measurements.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5. The repo openarrhenius covers fitting Ea for a single step.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that fit k1 and k2 of A -> B -> C to synthetic noisy data and show the uncertainty.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] k1 and k2 recovered within 5 percent at 2 percent noise
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a network animation with a catalyst switch
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a flowing network with a live plot and a catalyst switch on the bottleneck; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Network with at least four species and a catalyst switch
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add an implicit solver for stiff networks
body:
## Problem
Session 3 shows that explicit RK4 fails for stiff networks but only provides a linear backward Euler step.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 4. The enzyme cycle with k1 = 1e6 L/(mol s) is a good test.

## Expected outcome
A backward Euler or BDF solver with Newton iteration for nonlinear networks, with a test.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Within 1 percent of a fine reference with fewer than 2000 steps
- [ ] Test added

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
